items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/4771e7156d10e473ae859f9848a22014b97b3392.png"]Admonition scholars have uncovered an ancient ritual buried deep within their foul, heretic tomes. Using these fell rites, they have bound a powerful daemon into a Daemonhost. Agents report that this new horror seems to appear when others of its kin are slain.
Emboldened by the dreaded Daemonhost Gormaggoth’s presence, the streets are plagued with lesser Daemonhosts. Seek them out and destroy them.
Starting today until November 5, participate in the event by playing missions with the ‘Hunted’ condition, and destroy the Daemonhosts.

Beware, the Daemonhost Gormaggoth has an ever-increasing chance of appearing for every one of its kin you slay. Uncover more about the origin of these heretical abominations as you battle this terrible foe.
This event has two forms of progression!
Killing Daemonhosts in missions with the ‘Hunted’ condition will progress your personal event tracker, which rewards you with Dockets, Diamantine, Plasteel, and this brand new Weapon Charm:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/5559d1f5f5c37fe1d89b7e4a161a9cd037b6c9eb.png"]

Dealing damage to the dreaded Daemonhost Gormaggoth will advance a community event tracker, which every player contributes to! This rewards the entire playerbase with Dockets, Diamantine and Plasteel, as well as unlocking new lore short stories (written by Dan Abnett!) with each step.
If the community racks up enough damage, the Daemonhost Gormaggoth will be slain for good, unlocking this brand new Portrait frame:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/a7577d94bce9aac5c6fb6eb29832d52c58f9ff56.png"]
Hotfix 1.13.4 is now being rolled out on all platforms, and while you wait for it to download you can read the notes below!
This hotfix contains a handful of important fixes, including reducing the Vanguards’ health and fixing some crashes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/e700de79b8874e18ab7140f6074ba98f94e5b7ee.png"]
Scab Vanguard & Dreg Vanguard: reduced their health back to their correct, intended values.
Fixed crash affecting players on AMD RX 7000 series GPUs. As a workaround, FSR 4.1.1 has been disabled for RDNA3 GPUs on Windows 10.
Fixed startup crash on Intel Arc GPUs linked to the XeSS module.
Fixed a crash that could occur when tracking any of the removed "The Depths Purge the Unclean" Penances
Fixed the launcher so that it doesn't create a crash dump file on shutdown.
Fixed an issue where the launcher could block players from starting the game.
Fixed some clipping with Drill Fatigues (Cadian 43rd, Broken Swords, XXXXL)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/e700de79b8874e18ab7140f6074ba98f94e5b7ee.png"]
Scab and Dreg Vanguard enemies currently have slightly more health than intended.
Fixed!
We’ve also got some comments on a few of the changes we’ve done in the last few updates:
Corruption Damage Change

In the previous Hotfix (1.13.3) we changed how Corruption Damage is dealt. Previously, corruption damage alone couldn't outright kill you. This was only ever intended for Grimoire damage, and so we 'fixed' it for other damage sources. However, we understand that this is being relied upon by many as a feature, and so we'll keep an extra close eye on this.
Servo-Skull Damage Nerf

In the Depths of the Damned Update (1.13.0) the Servo-Skull had its Strength reduced from 160 to 100. This was an internal change that was meant to go live with the release of Skitarii in 1.12.0, meaning this was the original intended power level of the Servo-Skull, which instead went live on 1.13.0.

This brings us to today. Although the Servo-Skull now has the initially intended Strength, we are re-evaluating if the nerf was justified and are considering further balance adjustments to both it and the Noospheric Command Talent.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/e700de79b8874e18ab7140f6074ba98f94e5b7ee.png"]
That’s all for today!
We’ll see you on the Mourningstar.
– The Darktide Team

Hotfix 1.13.3 is now being rolled out on all platforms, and while you wait for it to download you can read the notes below!

(Havoc) Weakened Monstrosities can no longer spawn for the duration of the event.
Specialist Surge Strikes can no longer occur during the event.
Expeditions: Players who disconnect when there is a rescue reward for them will now be replaced by a pickup near the respawn beacon containing the reward.
The Relic Blade Sprint Heavy Stab buff from held charge while sprinting can now also be triggered while dashing through the ‘Chastise the Wicked’ / ‘Fury of the Faithful’ Abilities.
Removed the Penance related to Heretical Idols in the ‘Depths’ zone.
Dev Note: We are planning to add back this Penance in a future update that will add Heretical Idols to the Spillway mission.
Fixed an issue where Veteran’s ‘Executioner’s Stance’ Ability could not be refreshed by kills performed through sticky attacks (e.g. Special activated attacks with the Assault Chainsword).
Pack Master: Fixed an issue where all of their strikes would apply the Stamina and Dodge Reset debuff to players.

Scab & Dreg Vanguards: Fixed an issue where certain attacks caused an incorrect stagger reaction.
Fixed an issue where Medicae Stations would fail to display their usage cost.
Fixed an issue where the Scrap amount displayed after hot joining would be incorrect.
Fixed an issue where flickering could be experienced when transitioning into the Prophet of Decay intro cutscene.
Fixed an issue where a red hitmarker would be displayed on every hit after already having killed the Prophet of Decay, before transitioning to the outro cutscene.
Fixed Companion nameplates not updating the name after a Personality Scourge.

Fixed an issue where the Skitarii ‘Power Drive’ upgrade talent for the ‘Overload’ Keystone sometimes could fail to give the correct amount of stacks after using the ‘Advanced Combat Doctrines’ Ability, if it had consumed all the available Capacitance charges in one use.
Fixed a rare crash that could happen if a player started spectating a Psyker just as the operative gained an amount of Peril.
Fixed a crash that could happen if a player exited a mission or the Meat Grinder while a smoke cloud effect was active (e.g. Veteran’s ‘Smoke Grenade’).
Fixed an issue where Corruption damage would fail to kill players that had a fully corrupted Health bar.
Fixed an issue where Zealot’s ‘Until Death’ talent could be triggered when receiving Corruption damage while at 1 Health point, even if the Health bar was otherwise not fully corrupted.
Fixed an issue where Psyker’s ‘Empyric Recovery’ Penance could not be completed.
Fixed an issue where Skitarii’s ‘Sicarian Disciple’ Penance could not be completed.
Fixed an issue where Skitarii’s ‘Advanced Combat Doctrines’ Ability could lock-on friendly players instead of enemies after having tried to use the Artificer Servo-Skull Blitz at 0 charges.
Fixed an issue where Skitarii’s ‘Chordclaw Strike’ Ability would play an incorrect sound effect.
Fixed an issue where stacks from the ‘Blaze Away' and 'Inspiring Barrage' weapon Blessings could be reset when shooting in ADS stance with the Ogryn’s Thugshot weapon.
Fixed an issue where Ogryn’s ‘Lucky Bullet’ triggers from talents could reset the ‘Blaze Away’ weapon Blessing stacks for the Kickback and Thugshot weapon families.
Fixed an issue where Ogryn’s ‘No Stopping Me!’ talent would not be applied when charging the Heavy 2 attack on both Battle Maul & Slab Shield weapon marks.
Fixed an issue where an incorrect additional notification was displayed when reaching the max Mastery level for the Ogryn’s Battle Maul & Slab Shield weapon family.
Fixed an issue where the Mortis Trials Skitarii’s ‘Hard-Wired Reaction Boost’ buff would consume a larger than intended amount of Capacitance when triggered.
Fixed an issue where locked missions appeared as unlocked on the mission board.
Fixed an issue where players would be blocked from matchmaking if a Strike Team member changed operatives at a specific timing.
Fixed some potential frame drops when using the Emote Wheel or Communication Wheel if DLSS is enabled.
The Audio Devices list is now properly evaluated when changed and is updated in the audio settings.
Fixed a minor issue where the Vostroyan Flak Coat with Psykana Collar had inconsistent shoulder pads.
Fixed an issue where the Athonian 98th Fatigues sleeves clipped with the vambraces.
Fixed an issue where the muzzle of Ursula's Hope would not heat up visually.
Fixed a material issue where metal parts was displayed incorrectly on Brute Model Cranial Implant (XXXXL), Commemorative head screws, and Cranial-Coolant Implant.
Fixed an issue where Tanker Commander's Battlegear Cadian 802nd unintentionally changed colour - we restored the item to use the original colour again.
Fixed an issue where Mordian Cleric Jacket intersected with many lower body cosmetics.

That’s all for today!
We’ll see you on the Mourningstar.

Patch 1.13.0 is now being rolled out on all platforms! The ‘Depths of the Damned’ Free Update is releasing later today, at 14:00 CEST. In the meantime, you can check out the patch notes below to read all about the changes, as well as the content coming with the Free Update, such as the new mission, new weapons, and more!

notes.title: New Story Mini-Campaign: Terrors of the Deep

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/080a5c556568682c2a674da3e04adcc4a6c55cb8.png"]

This update comes with a brand new Story Mini-Campaign, a series of three missions with a connected narrative, similar to the ‘Battle for Tertium’ campaign or the ‘No Man’s Land’ mini-campaign. The first two missions will be in ‘Consignment Yard’ and ‘Enclavum Baross’, as the Strike Team sets out to aid noble allies of the Inquisition.

The third and final mission will be in ‘Spillway’, a brand new mission releasing with this update. The Strike Team must venture into the depths of the Torrent to aid the Ragged King and investigate the hidden horrors…
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/e3d4ce3d10a74d753b2f5307d735d0616364bb4f.png"]

Descend to the depths of the Torrent in the new mission: Spillway. The Ragged King is losing Water Cartel members to something lurking in the warren of sewers beneath the ancient dam. Get down there, clear out the Traitorous Sixth and deal with whatever has made its lair down there.
Read all about it in our previous Feature Highlight, here!

notes.title: New Boss: The Prophet of Decay

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/7b806f9b0bd226be9929ae2a03a199b9d1dd9bc3.jpg"]

Overview
An industrial sledgehammer of immense weight and size, this weapon can only be wielded by equally enormous Ogryns.
While each swing is ponderous, it also carries huge stagger, above average cleave potential, and amazing reach.
The moveset of the weapon is straightforward, allowing to chain attacks in a pleasing, destructive rhythm.
Additionally, if the windup of an Heavy or Special attack is maintained for a longer period of time, the weapon will accumulate up to 4 stacks of +10% Melee Strength for the following attack.
This weapon is available to the Ogryn class.
Weapon Special
Pressing the Special input initiates a unique windup animation, raising the Cruncher above the Ogryn’s head and giving access to devastating Strikedown attacks.

If the Special input is released immediately, the weapon will perform a Light 1 or Light 4 attack (depending on the combo chain); if the input is held, the weapon will release an Heavy Special Strikedown attack.
Attacks
Light 1: Moderately fast, vertical Strikedown attack with good Impact and Damage.
Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2, or Light 4 and Special 2.
Light 2: Moderately fast, diagonal Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave.
Chains into Light 3 and Heavy 1, or Light 1 and Special 1.
Light 3: Moderately fast, diagonal uppercut Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave.
Chains into Light 4 and Heavy 2, or Light 4 and Special 2.
Also accessed while in a Slide stance.
Light 4: Moderately fast, vertical Strikedown attack with good Impact and Damage.
Chains into Light 1 and Heavy 1, or Light 1 and Special 1.
Heavy 1: Slow, horizontal Relentless attack with great Cleave and Impact over secondary targets.
Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2, or Light 4 and Special 2.
Heavy 2: Slow, horizontal Relentless attack with great Cleave and Impact over secondary targets.
Chains into Light 3 and Heavy 1, or Light 1 and Special 1.
Push-attack: Fast, horizontal Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave.
Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2, or Light 4 and Special 2.
Special 1: Very slow, vertical Strikedown attack with great Damage and Impact.
Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2, or Light 4 and Special 2.
Special 2: Very slow, vertical Strikedown attack with great Damage and Impact.
Also accessed after a Push.
Chains into Light 3 and Heavy 1, or Light 1 and Special 1.
Suggested Horde combos
Push-attack > L2/H2 > …
(Slide) > L3 > H2 > …
Suggested Single Target combos
Sp1 > Sp2 > Sp1 > …
L1 > (Special) L4 > L1 > …
(Any) > Sp1/Sp2 > …
(Any) > (Special) L1/L4 > …
Blessings
Hammerblow
+19-25% Impact for 1.5s on Hit. Stacks 5 times.
Execution
+5-20% Damage Bonus vs Staggered enemies.
All or Nothing: Up to +15-30% Strength, as Stamina depletes. (Note that this version of the Blessing scales for every 12.5% depleted Stamina, instead of 20%.)
Limbsplitter: +17.5-25% Strength on your First Attack every 2 seconds.
Slow and Steady: Recover 15-24% toughness when hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, based on charge time.
Shock & Awe: - 30-60% Enemy Hit Mass for 3s on Kill.
Unstoppable Force: Fully Charged Heavy Attacks ignore Enemy Hit Mass and have +2.5-10% Damage.
Take a Swing: +45-60% Weak Spot Damage for 6 seconds on Pushing Enemies.
Overview
This mark of the Crusher family sports the signature high-finesse Push-attack uppercut, and has easy access to looping Strikedown and Relentless attack chains.
The Special activation is more powerful, but also limited by a cooldown.
This weapon is available to the Zealot and Arbites classes, and unlocked from the Crusher weapon family Mastery track.
Weapon Special
The Special action empowers the weapon for a short amount of time, causing the next hit to trigger a shockwave around the point of impact.
This explosion has more damage, impact and range compared to the one from the Indignatus mark, but also enters a cooldown of several seconds before the Special activation can be performed again.
Attacks
Light 1: Fast, vertical Strikedown attack with good Impact and Damage.
Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2.
Light 2: Fast, horizontal Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave.
Chains into Light 3 and Heavy 1.
Light 3: Fast, diagonal Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave, and increased Damage.
Chains into Light 4 and Heavy 2.
Also accessed after a Special activation.
Light 4: Fast, diagonal Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave, and increased Damage.
Chains into Light 1 and Heavy 1.
Heavy 1: Slow, horizontal Relentless attack with great Cleave and Impact over secondary targets.
Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2.
Heavy 2: Slow, diagonal Strikedown attack with great Damage and Impact.
Chains into Light 3 and Heavy 3.
Heavy 3: Slow, vertical Strikedown attack with great Damage and Impact.
Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2.
Also accessed after a Special activation.
Push-attack: Fast, diagonal uppercut Vanguard attack with good Damage and Cleave, and increased Finesse.
Chains into Light 4 and Heavy 2.
Also accessed while in a Slide stance.
Suggested Horde combos
Push-attack / Slide Light attack > L4 > …
Special activate > L3 > …
Suggested Single Target combos
Push-attack / Slide Light attack > H2 > …
Special activate > H3 > …

A pump action shotgun, Commonly used on Atoma. Fires devastating cones of pellets. Very effective close to mid range.
This weapon is available to the Veteran, Zealot, Psyker and Hive Scum classes.
Weapon Special
Flashlight. Be there light, followed by pellets.
Blessings
Terrifying Barrage: Suppress Enemies within 5-8m Radius on Close Range Kill.
Full Bore: +14-20% Strength for 5s when every bullet in a shot hits the same enemy.
Born In Blood: +4.5-6% Toughness on Close Range Kill.
Speedload: +7-10% Reload Speed for 3 seconds after Close Kill. Stacks 5 times.
Flechette: 3-6 Bleed Stacks on Critical Hit.
Gloryhunter: +10-16% Toughness on Elite Kill.
No Respite: Up to +14-20% Damage on Hit (Staggered Enemy), scaling with Stagger.
Scattershot: +6-12% Critical Chance for each Enemy Hit by your previous attack. Stacks 5 times.

Standard issue double barreled shotgun. Opposite to the sawed off, this mark shoots both barrels from the hip, and single shot when aiming down sights.
This weapon is available to the Veteran, Zealot, Psyker, Arbites and Hive Scum classes, and unlocked from the Double-Barrelled Shotgun weapon family Mastery track.

Bash to the face if enemies are close and both barrels are empty.

A slug shot variant of the Kickback.
Being an Ogryn weapon it is like wielding a human cannon, as the slug is giant sized.
This weapon is available to the Ogryn class.
Weapon Special
Bash the heretic! Counts as a Heavy attack.
Blessings
Run ‘n Gun: You can Hipfire with this weapon while Sprinting. +6-15% Close Damage while Sprinting. Also reduces weapon spread at all times by 30%.
Surgical: +10% Critical Chance for every 0.35-0.2 seconds while aiming. Stacks 10 times. Discharges all stacks upon firing.
Pierce: Special Attacks gain +10-25% Stagger and ignore Hit Mass Bonus from Armour.
Blaze Away: +6-9% Strength for every shot fired during continuous fire. Stacks 5 times.

Terrifying Barrage: Suppress Enemies within 5-8m Radius on Close Range Kill.
Inspiring Barrage: +1-4% Toughness for every shot fired during continuous fire. Stacks 5 times.
Expansive: +30-42% Melee Strength for 3.5s on Hitting 3+ Enemies with a Ranged Attack.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/e700de79b8874e18ab7140f6074ba98f94e5b7ee.png"]
AMD FSR MLD update
Updated to AMD FSR SDK 2.3.0, which includes several ML-based rendering improvements.

Added a new Reflection Denoiser option for ray-traced reflections on certain GPUs: AMD FSR Ray Regeneration, an alternative to the existing NRD denoiser. It can be selected in the Video settings menu when Ray Traced Reflections are enabled, and is designed to reduce noise in reflections.
Updated Nvidia Streamline to version 2.12.0
This version gives general stability improvements & enhanced resource and frame tracking.
Added End Of Round statistics.
Pressing the corresponding button during the end of a mission (default Tab / L3) will show a breakdown of various stats from your actions during the last mission, as well the entire team’s.
Higher difficulties will now spawn more Tech-Remnants (the higher the difficulty, the more Tech-Remnants will spawn).
Increased experience, mastery, and ordo docket rewards for completing Expeditions (scaled with the number of Tech-Remnants extracted).
Tweaked Pacing Manager settings for Expeditions.
The amount of crafting materials spawned now varies between zones (later zones will have more, with a sharp increase on the last one).
Expedition Extraction rewards are now increased based on the number of players that successfully extract.
2 players = +10%, 3 players = +15%, 4 players = +20%.
Players should no longer inherit damage from Bots when hotjoining into an Expeditions mission.
Sand Dust particles are toned down in Expeditions missions during the ‘Dawn’ condition.
When hotjoining into an Expeditions mission, you will now inherit Salvage that the team gathered during the current location.
Players that reconnect to a live Expeditions mission are given back any Salvage they earned before leaving.
Expeditions luggable loot (such as Data Reliquaries) now becomes tracked on the Auspex when a player picks it up.
Adjusted framing of portrait Frames to show more of the face and headgear and less of the neck.
Added more detailed Operator Stats in the Loadout and Talents screen.

Pressing the corresponding button (Default: W / LT / L2) while in the Loadout or Talents screen shows detailed current stats for your Operator, taking into account currently equipped gear, talents and passives.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/5568dddf4a059a4b024f0af3ba76e79dbf4000b3.png"]
Adjusted framing of Ogryn portrait Frames to be slightly less zoomed in.
The Servo Skull companion has been added to the Skitarius class selection screen.
Improved the visuals of the voice modulation visualization in the Skitarii Voxcaster customization step.
Locked campaign missions will now only display the last unlocking step needed, unless the steps can be completed independently.
If you are hit during the throwing animation of an objective item, you now keep throwing the item instead of dropping it.
Updated the Hive Scum ‘Battering Momentum’ talent description to better reflect the Cleave increase being applied to both melee and ranged attacks.
Skitarii’s ‘Advanced Combat Doctrines’ now always aims towards the head of a Chaos Spawn.
Added additional tagging validation to prevent Tagging on enemies not near the point of the player's aim.
Slightly reduced memory use in various menus.
Added various improvements on loadout presets to improve validation of missing items or talents, as well as how they store the loadout information.

As part of the Depths of the Damned Free Update, we have a balance update. Our focus has been on improving the base classes talent trees, overall class balance, weapon balance, and addressing Golden Toughness and its impact on both player builds and our overall design space for the future. Since we are making changes that will affect all players, regardless of class and loadout, it’s important for us to go through our thought process.

The original four Classes are receiving several changes to their talent trees, with a particular focus on reducing the number of stat nodes required to complete your build, and improving the paths through the trees with the intent of providing more interesting choices and improving buildcraft. We are also looking to reinforce what makes the Veteran and Zealot stand out from the other Classes, by taking a closer look at their themes and mechanics. The Skitarius has now had some time to settle, so we are also going over its talents and abilities and making some targeted adjustments. NOTE: Since the changes affect the layout of the trees, your loadouts may need slight rearrangements to amend broken connections or reapplying of points to make up for removed talents. Rest assured that these are only partial resets.
Several Melee Weapons are also receiving changes, with the Thunder Hammer in particular getting some extra attention.

Finally, we are taking a closer look at Golden Toughness. In May, we outlined our intention to improve combat balance by addressing some of the outliers in player power, and took the first steps by adjusting Carapace Armoured enemies and the players tools to deal with them. You can read that balance blog here.

Our commitment is still to preserve the intensity of the combat, while making it more stable, more readable, and more supportive of different builds and loadouts. Adjusting Golden Toughness is another step towards that long-term goal.
Golden Toughness is one of the more disruptive mechanics in Darktide. By changing the way damage and toughness interact, it can obscure some of the core rules of combat.

Many players are naturally guided towards abilities that provide Golden Toughness, and these abilities can be highly effective even before a player has developed a strong understanding of the mechanics they are intended to learn, e.g. positioning, and how to engage each type of enemy. This can allow difficult situations to be bypassed or diffused without engaging with the underlying threats, making it harder for players to build that understanding through the intended learning curve.

When Golden Toughness was first introduced to Abilities, Darktide was in a very different state. Since then, the overall difficulty and complexity of the game has increased, and the value of Golden Toughness has increased alongside it. As its value has grown, it has also become increasingly difficult to balance abilities against one another without making Golden Toughness a prerequisite for competing with its level of defensive power.

We want Toughness to have consistent and understandable rules regardless of how it is obtained. To that end, we are removing the Spillover Immunity effect from Golden Toughness. It will now follow the same damage calculation rules as regular Toughness.

This means that Golden Toughness will continue to provide additional protection, but it will no longer allow a single point of Toughness to fully absorb the damage of an otherwise lethal attack. The result should be a more consistent combat system, and greater room for us to balance defensive abilities against one another.

releases.displayName: Free Update - Depths of the Damned - Coming September 29!

items.text: On September 29, Get ready to return to Tertium and venture deeper into the Hive than ever before! The Depths of the Damned update introduces a new mini story campaign to Darktide, which reaches its climax in the brand new level, Spillway!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/13ed815078f020fd7c86e5951e0689f6900840cb.png"]

This new mission sends players into the deep and dangerous recesses of the Hive. The notorious domain of the Water Cartel is a sprawling labyrinth of tunnels, waterways and forgotten passages, crawling with chaos, decay and threats best left undisturbed. Spillway's journey is far from straightforward; strike teams must choose their paths wisely, and some routes are more perilous than others.

Expanded Arsenal: The warband is expanding their armory against Chaos with six new weapons coming to Darktide! Players will be able to unleash a mix of both new weapon marks and families accessible to a range of in-game classes.
For the new weapon families, Darktide is introducing the Ogryn Cruncher, Huntsman’s Shotgun and the Ogryn Thugshot.
The new weapon marks include the Crusher Krourk MK VII, Double-Barrelled Shotgun Krouk Mk IV, Gromm Mk I Battle Maul and Mk V Slab Shield.
For a more in depth breakdown of the weapons, keep an eye on our Feature Highlight coming soon!
[img src="https://europe1.discourse-cdn.com/flex013/uploads/fatshark/original/3X/6/a/6a607350e2fb9737443780fc7a2535d47332921e.gif"]

Face The Prophet of Decay: Deep within the Hive, something has taken root. Little is yet known about the Prophet of Decay, save for one grim certainty...they are no ordinary spawn of Chaos. A powerful Psyker, the Prophet has made the depths of the Torrent its domain, and what awaits the Strike Teams in the dark remains to be seen.
Other Transmissions from the Hive: Alongside the above, the Depths of the Damned update will also feature additional content such as a new live event, store rotation and quality of life improvements.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/e700de79b8874e18ab7140f6074ba98f94e5b7ee.png"]
That’s all we have for today! We hope you look forward to the Depths of the Damned update, as well as the Feature Highlights that we’ll be releasing!
We’ll see you on the Mourningstar.
– The Darktide Team
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/fa3cee2079e910edbbe49c053b98eb537ff631c5.png"]

Today’s patch comes with several tweaks and fixes. After feedback from you all we have done some balance changes to the Vanguard enemies, decreasing their health, modified their block radius and added a new way for you to stagger them.

We also took a look at the Blitzes available to the Skitarii class and made some adjustments. There are plenty of other things going into Patch 1.12.4, and it is now being rolled out on all platforms, notes are below!

Dev Note for our Xbox Series S players: To alleviate memory, and to prevent crashes, there is now a black pre-loading screen that appears before the Valkyrie loading screen when you go into a mission. This shouldn’t change the loading time length. We have other memory saving solutions that we will implement in a future patch, and we aim to return to the normal loading screen once those are implemented.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/6dd9b364f87d23b253e1c6db590883bc4396bf8e.png"]
Note: Values denote difficulty (Uprising / Malice / Heresy / Damnation & Auric)
Scab Vanguard
Dreg Vanguard
Blocking radius decrease
The Blocking radius has been decreased from 120 degrees to 100 degrees
Note: This is the Half-moon we check in front of the enemy to consider if they are guarding against attacks
We’ve lowered the amount of Vanguard enemies allowed to spawn concurrently in mission mid and end Events
New stagger available
It’s now possible to heavily stagger a Vanguard by Pushing them twice in a rapid fashion; this will make them stumble backwards and open to be attacked.
Mechanicus Power Sword
Fixed an issue where the Finesse and First Target stats would not correctly apply their scaling to Special activated attacks
Increased the Melee Strength bonus scaling on Special charges from +4% to +5% (max at 6 charges from +24% to +30%)
Added a new Light 5 diagonal Vanguard attack, chained from Light 4 and chaining back into Light 4 / Heavy 3
Changed the scaling of the Mobility stat to provide an additional effective Dodge when exactly at 80% stat.
Slight range and hitbox increase for all attacks
Slight movespeed curve increase for Heavy windups and attacks
Paired Transonic Blades
Fixed an issue where Light attacks could be repeated at way faster than intended rate when quickly swapping between wielded weapons/items.
Fixed an issue where the Cleave Efficiency stat would fail to scale the damage on secondary targets for most attack profiles.
Dev Note: 2nd target ADMs for profiles that use both weapons (Slayer Heavy 2, Dueller Heavy 1) have been tweaked to avoid scaling their damage higher than the 1st target due to the above change.
Changed the Crit Chance scaling for the Critical Bonus stat from 0-8% to 0-10%
Added a new alternative crosshair for melee weapons with a Special mode switch
The new circle crosshair will be displayed when the Special is enabled, instead of the standard dot crosshair
The alternative crosshair behaviour can be turned off in the Interface Options, through the ""Weapon Special Crosshair"" toggle
Paired Transonic Blades
Sapper Shovel
Latrine Shovel
Crowbar
Bone Saw
Mechanicus Power Sword and Arc Maul
Tweaked the HUD element which represent the Special charges to have better visibility against the background in different lighting situations
Increased the contrast and opacity of the HUD, both when the Special is activated or deactivated
Removed the fade out of the HUD when at full Special charges
‘Decapitator’ weapon blessing
Changed the “One-Shot” enemy current health requirement from 100% to 80%
Changed stacks to decay one by one instead of all at once
Updated the duration and scaling per stack over Blessing tiers for all weapon families:
Combat Axe
Duration from 8s to 5s
Power Falchion
Duration from 8s to 5s
Bone Saw
Duration from 8s to 5s
Mechanicus Power Sword
Duration from 4s to 5s

Dev Note: The requirements for the ‘Decapitator’ Blessing are now more lenient, allowing for enemies which are lightly damaged to still trigger the effects. Note however that the killing hit will still need to deal damage equal or higher than the maximum health of the enemy to be considered a One-Shot.
Additionally, we have updated the stacks to decay one by one over time instead of all at once, to further increase the consistency of the Blessing.

Since the uptime of the Blessing effects will be higher after the changes, we have rebalanced accordingly the values of the Finesse bonus and aligned the duration of each stack to 5s for all the weapon families.
‘Machine Spirit Resurgent’ weapon blessing
Lowered cooldown scaling over tiers from 6/5/4/3s to 5.5/4.5/3.5/2.5s
Dev Note: We’ve taken a pass on the Blitz Abilities of the Skitarius with the goal of aligning their power levels in comparison to each other and improving their usability.
Arc Grenades
Updated Arc Damage application to increase consistency

Dev Note: Damage is now delivered through a short duration (0.5s) Debuff instead of direct damage. This change also affects Voltaic Resistance (Integrated Refraction Emitter Sub Node) and Voltaic Arcs (Voltaic Emitter Sub Node). The average damage per enemy should increase compared to before.

Now generates 4% Capacitance for each Elite or Specialist Killed by the Arc Grenade.
Servo-Skulls
Purgator and Medicae Servo-Skulls

Purgator Servo-Skull
Burn stacks per hit 1 -> 2

Noospheric Command
Can now only be used if you have the required Capacitance available.
Integrated Refraction Emitter
Charges replenish every 75s.

No longer replenished by picking up Grenade Boxes

[p align="start"]Hotfix 1.12.3 is now being rolled out on all platforms. It just has a small fix, but we would like to take the opportunity to quickly cover some feedback we have received since the release of the Skitarii Class.

[p align="start"]Since the Omnissiah blessed the Mourningstar with the arrival of the Skitarii, we’ve been keenly listening to the feedback you have shared regarding them. We are currently looking at their Blitz Abilities , addressing the issues regarding balance, usability, and how they fit into the kit of the Skitarii.
[p align="start"]We are also looking at the Skitarii Melee Weapons, and we are planning some fixes and changes to stat scaling and also a set of specific tweaks for the Mechanicus Power Sword.
[p align="start"]Finally, we have heard your feedback on the new enemy, the Vanguard, and we are hard at work on tweaking and balance for them too.
[p align="start"]We still need some time to get this right, so these fixes are coming in the next patch, that should be with you all just after summer break.
[p align="start"]

notes.title: Special Live Event: Heretical Artifacts - 14:00 CEST

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/0b2c9f222ee1077b82fd32eae2f0310f65153fb6.png"]The Admonition have been sighted gathering relics and sacred effigies and doing…unnatural things to them. Strike teams have been tasked with retrieving these stolen artifacts and returning them to Tertium's clerics.

Starting from later today, at 14:00 CEST, players can participate in the event by joining missions with the ‘Relics in Ruins’ modifier to recover relics from the cultists. Once back in the Mourning Star, visit Sire Melk to deliver your recovered relics, and choose which faction to give them to.
The Adherents of Saint Messelina, which will bestow players with an increased coherency radius, alongside boosted attack and movement speed.
The Scourge of the Faithless, which endows players with increased damage, burn damage and burn duration.
Participating in the event will reward players with Ordo Dockets, Plasteel, Diamantine, and this brand new Portrait Frame!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/bafd66d1de97aa23a7fb83e02815c79c30307459.png"]
A new threat approaches…
Human melee bruisers equipped with breakable shields, these new enemies will bolster the enemy hordes and make them tougher to crack!

The Scab variant is equipped with a harder more durable shield that will last longer, but comes in more scarce numbers, while their Dreg equivalents are more numerous but only equipped with scrappy handmade shields that are more prone to breaking
Even without the shield, these vanguards are stronger than their non-shielded counterparts.

As part of our ongoing balance commitment continuing on from the previous reduction to Ogryn enemies (and at the time, specifically the Crusher), with the release of the Vanguards we’ve reduced the amounts of Bulwarks throughout the missions.
The Packmasters have moved beyond the wastes of Atoma to reinforce their brethren in Tertium
Packmasters will now appear outside of Expeditions, across the other gamemodes starting from Heresy level difficulty and up.
Improved mobility: the Packmasters will now have an easier time keeping up with a retreating player
The amount of Pox Hounds spawned with the Packmaster has been changed to be based on the difficulty, with an increase of the armoured version at higher difficulty levels.

A brand new Mark has been added to the Plasma Gun, the Mk III! Available to the Veteran class and the (releasing today!) Skitarii class, this Plasma Gun variant has less focus on piercing through enemies in favor of devastating explosive power. Give it a try!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/1a8be856b8760f89d585ce833c9abb1ce6e2ffba.png"]
This update also sees an injection of new content into the Expeditions game mode, as well as various quality of life changes and reworks of certain systems!
New time of day: Dawn
New Scavenge Zone
New Sites of Interest, with electric hazards!
New Deadsider Sanctuary.
Reworked how Tech-Remnants are shared.
Players no longer have a personal Tech-Remnant pool. Instead, Tech-Remnants picked up by a member of the strike team are added to the team’s shared pool.
Whenever a player dies (does not apply to bots), the team’s pool is reduced by 25%.
This only happens if the team has more than 100 Tech-Remnants.
50% of this value is dropped at the spot where the player died.
The team can retrieve the remaining 50% of the deducted value if they rescue the player that died.
If a hog-tied player is teleported to a Deadsider Sanctuary, the Tech-Remnants attached to them are lost.
For each alive player missing from the Valkyrie at the moment of extraction, 25% of the pool is reduced in the End of Round screen.

Skitarius displays "Tech-Warrior""
Changed targeting behaviour to make them more predictable. They should no longer be able to change targets while in their lunge state.
They should now always enter their explode state after being staggered by a Push from a Melee Weapon, even if they weren't in their lunging state.

Poxburster explosions triggered by navigation issues (e.g. failing to climb over terrain), or other non-player related events, should no longer cause damage; they will still knock players away if caught in them however.

This update has some minor tweaks and Hive Scum balance changes, and several bug and crash fixes.
On top of that…

As the Deadside and its climate is very volatile and unstable, the long range sensors of the Mourningstar struggle with updated information about enemy movement and the general lay of the land. This means that the Expedition Map will update on a regular basis, presenting new challenges and setups to explore.

With this update we begin our first Expedition Map rotation for the Expeditions Game Mode! Starting later today, the existing nodes have been wiped and replaced with a new set of unique nodes, complete with a new modifier and environment condition to keep things fresh!

The new grid points will have to be unlocked from the new starting node, as you begin another cycle of gathering Tech-Remnants and unlocking grid points. As Tech-Remnants are linked to each Expedition Map rotation, you’ll all start again on equal footing!

One of the nodes is special! To unlock it, the community as a whole must gather 200,000,000 Tech-Remnants total! Each member of the Strike Team is counted separately for this requirement, meaning that a team of four that extracts successfully will add their Tech-Remnants gathered to the pool four times at once.

Today’s update is quite big. We are introducing Expeditions, our new game mode, to Darktide. You will be able to venture on missions outside of Hive Tertium, and fight your way through more open landscapes than we usually have inside of the Hive. With Expeditions we are also introducing the Ogryn Pack Master, a new Monstrosity, and his companions, the Armoured Pox Hounds.

On top of this we are also implementing a number of balancing changes, with various refinements to both core game classes and the DLC ones, Arbites and Hive Scum. We have also made some balance changes to weapons.
Finally we have also added a bunch of quality of life improvements and bug fixes.
Patch 1.11.0 is now being rolled out on all platforms, and while you wait for it to download you can read the notes below! Let’s get right to it!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/7804dd0b4eac3cfe9b1dba13df18b5c0fc0da09b.png"]

A new game mode that can be accessed through the Expeditions Menu terminal, on the left side of the Mission Board. The players’ objective in the mode is to explore a sequence of Scavenge Zones in search of Tech-Remnants.
Scavenge Zones have randomly-spawned elements in them, so no two runs are the same.
Scavenge Zones are much more open and sandbox-like than regular Darktide missions.
The choice of when exactly to end a run is in the players’ hands - they can go to an extraction point and call a Valkyrie to come pick them up.
In-between Scavenge Zones, the players can visit Deadsider Sanctuaries - safe zones in which they can trade Salvage (an in-run currency found while exploring) for helpful items.
This includes completely new gadgets, like grenades that summon artillery strikes.
Each run has a time limit, since the environment outside of Tertium is heavily polluted.
Players start with 15 minutes on the clock.
Entering a Deadsider Sanctuary regenerates 5 minutes (still capped at 15).
After running out of time, the players start gaining corruption.
The corruption gain is slow at first and ramps up over time.
Corruption won’t build up past 1 HP.
During a run, the players can access their auspex to discover Sites of Interests - places that contain large quantities of Tech-Remnants.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/15e9bdb0ecaf68c365bae096cff339467aa3e671.png"]
The Expeditions map is a custom menu through which players access Expeditions - similar to the Mission Board for regular missions.
It presents the players with a map consisting of several nodes.
Each Grid Point is a unique configuration of Expeditions, with different randomization parameters.
This includes environmental modifiers like the Dust Vortex, and enemy modifiers like Hunting Grounds.
By extracting Tech-Remnants, players unlock more of the nodes on the map. The map will be changed at regular intervals, to ensure the mode stays fresh.

Expeditions are accompanied by Penances that reward players for engaging with the mode. These come with new cosmetic rewards, including a new set of cosmetic items for each of the four base classes, in two color schemes.

To accompany the release of the mode, players can take part in a new live event - Deadside Patrol. Starting today until April 6, playing Expeditions and extracting Tech-Remnants from runs will advance your progression in the Deadside Patrol event. Different tiers of the event will reward Plasteel, Diamantine and Ordo Dockets, and the final tier will award players with the following portrait frame:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/a3dc1f108b86c89d3a9b3b8c6c5b13514b851ede.png"]

The Pack Master and his hounds will initially spawn exclusively in the new game mode Expeditions.
New Armoured version of the Pox Hound, this dog is a bit slower and heavier than its unarmoured version; it will only show up together with the Ogryn Pack Master.

Dev Note: “Hey guys. This update sees a new layout for Hive Scum’s talent tree. We felt that the old version had some snags and a general sense of friction to it, so the whole thing has been redesigned to be more cost effective and dynamic.” - Teodor, class designer.
New layout added for Hive Scum Talent Tree.
Hive Scum Talents

Dev note: “We are also cleaning out a few lesser picked talents and replacing them with new ones or moving them somewhere else. We want the Hive Scum tree to feel as cohesive as we can, and this should be another step in the right direction, without losing the explosive feel of the class.”
One of the two +25 Toughness Boost nodes has been removed. Hive Scum’s Base Toughness has been increased from 75 to 100 to compensate.
Hive Scum now has +1 Effective Dodges by default, and the ‘Moving Target’ talent has been removed.
The talent ‘Like the Wind’ has been removed from the Talent Tree and is now active for Hive Scum by default.
Alley Rat +50% Dodge Distance.

“This talent acts as a twin to ‘Nimble’. They are mutually exclusive to one another and only one of them can be picked. As our most mobile class, Hive Scum should have plenty of customizability when it comes to how to dodge and move about.”
Street Tough When taking Melee Damage, knock all nearby Enemies around you backwards and gain +10% Movement Speed for 3s. Can only trigger once every 8s.
Channelled Devastation Each 1% of your current Critical Hit Chance grants a stack of +0.5% Melee Damage. Stacks 30 times (up to +15% Melee Damage).
Splash Damage Killing an Elite Enemy with a Melee Attack infects up to 10 enemies within 4m of the target with 2 stacks of Chem Toxin.
“Similarly to the Chem Grenade, this talent is also capped at 2 stacks of toxin, and only adds stacks up to that value.”
Virulent Strain When infecting an Enemy with Chem Toxin, increase their damage taken by +10% from all sources for 5s.
‘Loose Formation’.
‘Untouchable’.
‘Gang Tough’.

Dev Note: “We have changed how ‘Toxic Renewal’ works. The issue with the old version was that it was pretty easy for your kills to become swallowed by the toxin instead, which would deny the talent. This new version, while fundamentally different, should allow for good Toughness control while dipping into the toxin spreading archetype of the class.”
Toxic Renewal Replenish 1% Toughness every 1s for each Chem Toxin infected Enemy within 15m, up to a maximum of 10 Enemies.

Dev Note: “‘Pickpocket’ has been in the talks a lot lately. While a near infinite ammo source can become problematic, it is also a talent that the run-n-gun playstyle of Hive Scum greatly benefits from. So, we are making some targeted changes, leaning into Scum's usual deliberately aggressive and up-close playstyle for the bonus to take effect.”
Pickpocket Killing an Elite or Specialist Enemy with a Melee Attack while Ammo Reserve is below 20% will refill it to 20%.
Castigator’s Stance
Damage Resistance from 80% to 70%
New: Increase Strength by 20%
Writ of Execution
Max Stacks from 10 to 6

Blessed Armament
Cooldown from 1.5s to Once per attack
Nuncio-Aquila

Terminus Warrant - Reworked

Dev Note: Terminus Warrant has since the release of Arbites been one of the least popular keystones across all Classes. In this update we're trying to bring in changes that make it less difficult to get value out of.

New Description reads: Ranged Attacks grant stacks of Melee Justice for each Enemy Hit (max 20), Weakspot hits grant 3 stacks. Wielding your Primary Weapon spends your Melee Justice stacks to grant you +10% Melee Strength and +20% Toughness Damage Reduction for 12s.

Melee Hits grant stacks of Ranged Justice (max 20). Wielding your Secondary Weapon spends your Ranged Justice stacks to grant you +10% Ranged Strength, +50% Ranged Cleave and +50% Suppression for 12s.
Writ of Judgement
New Description reads: Spending 20 stacks grants +10% Melee and Ranged Attack Speed, as well as +10% Crit Chance for 12s.
Terminal Decree
New Description reads: For each stack you spend, replenish 1% Toughness to you and Allies in Coherency.
Obstinate

Dispense Justice
Removed

Toughness from 10% to 7.5%
Base Passive

Point Blank Barrage

Dedicated Practice

Telekine Shield

Bolstered Shield

Dev Note: Get Back in the Fight! was seldom picked, and even then with little success. With the changes to Plasma Gun this new Talent should come in handy:
New Talent: Withering Fire
Effect: +50% Ranged Cleave.

Damage from 3% to 5%
Stacks from 5 to 3

Dev Note: The differences between the two marks of Shivs were not large enough, leading the Mk I to outperform the Mk III even in its intended multi-target niche.
Improvised Mk I
Lowered base Cleave for Light attacks to {1.0, 3.0}, from {3.0, 5.0} for Light 1 / Light 3 and {2.0, 4.0} for Light 2 / Light 4
Improvised Mk III
Heavy Vanguard 1st target damage from {90,160} to {95,170}
Heavy Vanguard 1st target impact from {4,8} to {5,9}
Dev Note: While the Crowbar secondary stance provided good control and damage, it was often hard to use its attacks effectively in more involved situations.

The changes aim to lower the penalty when canceling out of a stuck attack, while also increasing the reward in damage when completing it. We are also slightly increasing the speed of the Special mode change action, to allow it to be weaved more easily into high-paced gameplay.
Stamina drain on canceling a stuck attack from 0.2 to 0.05 (lowered)
Damage for Heavy stuck attack second instance from {120,240} to {130,260}
Special mode change time scale from 1.1 to 1.2 (sped up around 10%)

Dev Note: The Thunder Hammer provides great damage when empowered, but was often lackluster when unempowered, especially against the Maniac type enemies. This would lead to situations where it was unable to have good options when faced with common enemy compositions.
Raised Armour Damage Modifier vs Maniac for multiple profiles:
Lights 1st target from 0.5 to 0.75
Lights other targets from 0.5 to 0.6
Heavy Relentless 1st target from 0.5 to 0.75
Heavy Relentless other targets from 0.5 to 0.6

Dev Note: The Heavy Sword is intended to have a weakness when it comes to the more heavily armoured enemies, and especially the ones clad in Carapace armour. However, this created a situation where spamming the Special attack was too often the best course of action, leading to a very one-dimensional gameplay experience.
In this update we are tweaking the Special attack, lowering its immediate damage output but making it a stronger opener for the following attacks thanks to a small Brittleness on-hit debuff.

The unique Light attack performed after the Special was also improved, with additional direct offensive properties but also making it able to cleave more easily through all armour types, including Carapace.
Finally, we reworked the Bladed Momentum blessing to provide a smaller maximum bonus that is in turn much easier to maintain.
Alongside the above changes, we also took a pass on the overall weapon family, cleaning up some rough edges and polishing several attack hitboxes and ranges.
Check out the post in the forums for the full list of changes, here!

Dev Note: The Power Falchion is a very reliable and easy to use weapon, but was lacking a little oomph when it came to its activated attacks. We are giving them a gentle bump to bring the family more in line with the other power weapon options.
Increased 1st target damage over all the Special active profiles by around 5-10%

Dev Note: The chain timings and input buffering for both Light and Heavy attacks on the Mk XV Heavy Eviscerator were particularly unintuitive, causing situations where attack chains could be dropped in an annoying fashion.
Tigrus Mk XV
Raised the buffer time for the Start Attack input
Lowered the chain timing to Block for the Heavy 1 and Heavy 2 attacks
Increased the chain timing to Unwield and Special activate for the Heavy 1 and Heavy 2 attacks
Dev Note: We had been a tad conservative when reworking the Paul Special with the introduction of a cooldown, but we think that the big man can be allowed more explosions on their bonking stick.
Special activate cooldown period from 8 to 6 (total Special cooldown from 12 to 10)
Dev Note: We are tweaking the Primary and Secondary fire of the Plasma Gun to encourage the use of both in different situations, instead of defaulting to the former in almost all cases.

The base Cleave of the Primary fire was significantly lowered, while still remaining top tier in the ranged arsenal (for comparison, the Stub Revolver Mk IIa has a base Cleave value of 6.5, while the Boltgun Mk IIb has 3). The newly introduced ‘Withering Fire’ Veteran talent can also be slotted in to significantly improve the Cleave of both the Primary and Secondary fire.
Conversely, ammo usage scaling for the Secondary fire was improved, allowing the weapon to consume less ammo when releasing either partially or fully charged shots.
Primary fire base Cleave lowered from Infinite to 18
Secondary fire base Cleave unchanged at Infinite
Secondary fire Ammo usage scaling improved from 5-9 to 1-8
Wield action time scale from 1.0 to 0.85 (slowed down)

Dev Note: The Infantry Lasgun’s are receiving upgrades in a few different aspects. To support it being an Infantry weapon, All marks get increased magazine capacity and ammo reserves. The Mk IIb is also getting a recoil reduction to support it utilizing its faster fire rate. Additionally, all marks will receive a minor increase to their hitscan radius, meaning that the hit registration will be more generous with close misses.
Check out the post in the forums for the full list of changes, here!

Dev Note: The Twin-Linked Heavy Stubbers are receiving an upgrade. The primary change is a reduction in maximum spread, allowing players to sustain fire more effectively. Additionally, the damage output and Armour Damage Modifiers have been slightly increased.
Check out the post in the forums for the full list of changes, here!

Dev Note: Attack strength interacts mainly with Talents that check for Light or Heavy attack types. We are increasing the attack strength of the Rippergun Special from Light to Heavy, allowing it to gain a larger benefit from Ogryn Talents like ‘The Best Defence’ and ‘Batter’.
Special bayonet attack strength from Light to Heavy

Dev Note: The Dual stubs landed a bit in the shadows of other options so we have increased some aspects to support a Run N Gun playstyle. Mostly focused on spread reduction but they also will receive a slight buff to base Damage, Special damage and Armour Damage Modifiers.

items.text: Added Quality of Life change to prevent Talent Trees from fully resetting when their layout receives changes in an update.

The Talent Trees will now try to rebuild themselves as best as they can if the Layout has seen changes. This might not always produce complete builds, but in such cases you will be notified in the UI that your Tree requires some manual help.
Penance track extension
We have extended the Penance track by 500 points, with accompanying new rewards.

Some Penance Descriptions specified that they could only be achieved by using the Base Abilities of the Class, which caused some confusion. We've added the Upgraded Ability variants to the descriptions as well.

Hive Scum Penances

releases.displayName: The new, free update, 'Beyond the Hive', is coming March 17!

items.text: [p align="start"]The new ‘Expeditions’ game mode is part of the ‘Beyond the Hive’ update: A high risk experience that drags players beyond the fortified walls of Tertium and into the desolate wreckage of Atoma Prime for the first time!

[p align="start"]Humanity once again has been faced with another looming threat. The Admonition has been sighted scouring the ruins outside of the hive in search of lost Tech-Remnants - which has not gone unnoticed by the Imperium. Whilst the chaos cultists’ motivations remain unknown at present, what is certain is war unfolds differently in Expeditions. Players must adapt quickly as there are no fixed routes, no clear front lines and no room for error!

[p align="start"]Design Director Victor Magnuson describes it as “the biggest injection of new content in the game since launch”. The fully loaded update offers an entirely new way to play Darktide, featuring new enemies, items, environmental threats, strategies and cosmetics!
[p align="start"]Key Features

Experience Darktide Like Never Before: Players are tasked with venturing into the desolate plains of Atoma Prime with a new mission objective: scour the planet for Tech-Remnants and investigate sites of interest on the map. Even the strongest reject can only survive the polluted air for a limited time - stay as long as you dare and call the Valkyrie for extraction when you choose. No two runs in Expeditions are the same, the badlands are unpredictable and each successfully completed excursion unlocks further missions.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/4b95e3459a05afe5f2602bf078e071c7311e4f2c.png"]

The War Has Expanded Beyond the Hive: Every moment spent outside the Hive alerts Chaos Spawn and monstrosities of players’ presence, drawing them closer. Load outs must be adapted to the open ruinous environments. Enemies can attack from every direction and aren’t confined to the claustrophobic frenzied battlegrounds within Tertium. Squads must choose when to fight, or flee, and adapt strategies to survive one of Darktide’s deadliest challenges yet. Expeditions is not for the faint of heart and is available for players midway into their character progression.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/2829241ef0b8e689b870f839e29fcb34f787ed25.png"]

New Threats: The environment is as toxic and deadly as the chaos that infects it. With twisters, lightning storms and a polluted atmosphere, peril lurks around every corner! Safe zones are scattered throughout the map… but they are fleeting sanctuaries. Step outside and hazards surround you once more from every angle. Forcing squads to move quickly, think tactically, and survive the unforgiving expanse of Atoma Prime!

More Fire Power. Fewer Survivors: Having the right instruments of destruction can mean the difference between extraction…and extinction! The new game mode introduces an arsenal of new items alongside modified and supercharged versions of existing ones in the Dead Side Sanctuary. The obliterating Modified Grenade can wipe all enemies in the vicinity…but draw more to the squads’ location.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/ea82d1c9cbfc1d05d7303f991cfdafaab72a582a.png"]

The Ogryn Pack Master Approaches: This monstrosity is uncharacteristically quick for an Ogryn! He can be found roaming the derelict plains of Expeditions Mode with his pack of Pox Hounds and Armoured Pox Hounds. A challenging adversary for the Arbites, who players will notice his unique and savage interactions with, isn’t a stranger to handling unruly hounds… Eliminating him quickly is wise as he will continually call his hell hounds to the battlefield, but his vocal nature gives players an advantage to spot him quickly.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/73f4cf9adabb00cd3d36d83845183a8c93954863.jpg"]
The Secrets of the Sands are Waiting: The Beyond the Hive update is loaded with new dangers and discoveries - read the dev blog here for a deeper dive into the Update. Expect more information soon!

Patch 1.10.6 is currently rolling out across our platforms. In the meantime, you can read the notes below.
This patch comes with adjustments to the Hive Scum talents, both to polish some interactions and improve on underused ones. It also includes some general cosmetics and bugfixes.

Developer’s note: “Hey guys. Hive Scum is getting a few changes in this update. This time, we’re targeting some general talent quirks and bringing them a bit more up to snuff. The Stimm Lab is getting the bigger changes, with a rework on one of its branches. Cheers.” - Teodor, class designer.
‘Stimm Lab’ Has gotten a buff on durability related talents (top left branch):

Any ‘Toughness Regeneration’ buffs have been swapped for ‘Toughness Replenishment’ (the original buff was only active while in coherency outside of combat. The latter modifies the amount of Toughness gained instead. This change should make the talents way more active and useful).

‘Barrage I-IV’ now grants 6.25% Toughness, +5% Toughness Replenishment and +4% Damage Reduction each (note: the Toughness gained from Barrage is not affected by its own Toughness Replenishment bonus. That bonus is applied to Toughness gained during the duration of the Cartel Special itself).
‘Tank’ now grants +30% Toughness Replenishment instead of +20%.
‘Regain’ now grants 5% Toughness every 1s for the duration of the Cartel Special, instead of 25% in one go.
‘Cheap Shots’ now grants +15% Strength against both medium and heavy staggered enemies, and +10% against light staggered enemies.

‘Nimble’ is now properly labeled as granting Dodge Speed. The bonus to dodge windows is also now a flat bonus instead of a multiplicative bonus. This means that, yes, it is applied to dodges against ranged fire, but won’t be as effective as when dodging against melee attacks, due to not having the default values that those types of dodges have.
Dodge Speed bonus changed from +25% to +0.15s.
‘Rampage!’ no longer makes the player “exhausted” after use, the ability now simply ends.
‘Channelled Aggression’ no longer requires the duration of Rampage to be above a certain threshold. It is now active throughout.
‘Unload’ now refreshes itself if triggered while active, and can be triggered by activating Desperado.
‘Pocket Toxin’ now infects enemies with different amounts of Chem Toxin depending on the equipped Blitz:
Blinder/Blackout: 3.
Boom Bringer: 6.
Chem Grenade: 10 (note: the talent adds stacks of Chem Toxin on explosion, meaning that the Chem Grenade grants them on its initial blast. The stacks added by the area of effect remains the same).
Now has an appropriately sized explosion radius that matches the visuals. There’s no real notable gameplay change, but it does mean that it can now properly benefit from ‘Pocket Toxin’.
Duration reduced from 20s to 15s to better align with similar Blitz abilities, like the Immolation Grenade.
New, more elaborate talent description.

‘Ranged-’ and ‘Melee Attack Immunity’ talents are now properly rewritten as ‘Counts as Dodging’, to convey how they actually work, and highlight that they also trigger dodges (which can interact with other talents in the Hive Scum tree).
‘Dodge Extended’ has been properly rewritten as ‘Dodge Speed’ (Dodge Speed does increase the length of the dodge, but the main benefit is the increase in speed).
Fixed an issue where the looping shooting sound for the Ogryn Twin-Linked Heavy Stubbers restarted on every bullet shot.
Fixed an outline issue when using the Desperado ability near Dreg Ritualist enemies in the Dark Communion mission.
Fixed an issue where damage from Needle Pistol Toxins didn't trigger effects from the Hive Scum Talents 'Speedloader' and 'Vulture's Mark'.
Fixed text formatting of objectives for Hive Scum's basic training step for the Ability.
Pyre Blade: fixed an issue where the VFX was not spanning the full length of the blade.
Antax Mk III Conclave-issue Tactical Helm: fixed the red visor.
Commando Beret with Augmetic Implant (Green): fixed some visual issues.
Pugilist Armour (XXXXL) (Tread Lightlies): fixed some clipping and physics issues

We’ll see you on the Mourningstar.
– The Darktide Team

Dev note: “Hi everyone. This update sees a handful of changes to the layout of the Hive Scum Talent Tree. Mainly, we are addressing the sharp difficulty curve of early game Hive Scum by moving a few stronger talents from the later sections of the tree further up. What’s important to note is that outside of fixes and touch-ups, there are no direct balance changes to individual talents as of yet, so the overall power level of Hive Scum is the same. Even so, please consider this a light first stab at the overall Hive Scum feel, and know that we are keeping a watchful eye. Oh, and your talents will not be reset (but your talents might have moved around in the new layout!). Talk to you soon. - Teodor, class designer.”

notes.title: New Story Campaign: The Road to No Man’s Land

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/b530a913b6ecc2d467b2b8680ba96cf50594ea12.png"]

A new story campaign has been added to Darktide! Similar to Battle For Tertium, play through three specific missions in a connected storyline, unlocking new chapters as you go. The first chapter starts with the Moebian 53rd fending off a heretical train hijacking via the Rolling Steel Operation, followed by Excise Vault Spireside-13 as the second chapter. The third and final chapter of this mini-campaign is the new Operation: No Man’s Land.
Alongside it are 3 penances, awarded for completing the campaign on various difficulties.
The new story is a permanent addition to the game, meaning that these missions will always be playable at any time.

Additionally, for anyone who wishes to play the new mission without going through the short story, we will make No Man's Land always available in the mission board for a week after its release. After that, it will be added to the regular mission rotation pool.

With the introduction of this, the “Campaign Playlist” has been renamed to “Special Assignments” and houses both the “Battle for Tertium” and “The Road to No Man’s Land” campaigns. These special assignments will introduce new content in a narrative way expanding Darktide’s living story.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/106cb2363be1776608ecd472ba65cac83a757cae.png"]
[p align="right"]“Good luck everyone.”

In a city as ancient, war-torn and enormous as Tertium, whole districts can fall into disrepair and be lost to the ravages of time. One such area, Consora’s Folly, has been taken over by the Admonition. Your job is to accompany Knight Commander Dragor and his Leman Russ Battletank, Lionheart, into this ruined zone. Your target: a long-lost fortress from a forgotten conflict, now a major base of operations for the insidious cult.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/6459491ab9c55c64a336d71e73837c89f47cd258.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/e700de79b8874e18ab7140f6074ba98f94e5b7ee.png"]
[p align="right"]“Big lad, bad attitude.”

Alongside the new Hive Scum class, as a special treat to celebrate our 3 year anniversary, we have a new, free, voice profile for the Ogryn. Fan favourite Tim Bentinck, known for his role as Victor Saltzpyre in the Vermintide series, lends his voice to the new “The Heavy” Ogryn personality!
The Heavy has spent time amongst the various cartels that run Tertium's underworld. He's loud, aggressive and fond of using rhyming slang, just like the Hive Scum.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/e700de79b8874e18ab7140f6074ba98f94e5b7ee.png"]

notes.title: Upcoming In-Game Live Event: The Day of Atonement

items.text: The stolen rations were tainted and now the hab blocks teem with infected. Atone for your deeds at the altars of Saint Messelina Gloriana.
This event will start on Thursday, December 4.

"Disturbing news has reached us from the poorer hab zones in Tertium. The recovered rations that were recently distributed to the unfortunate souls who reside in these districts appear to have been tainted. A great sickness has spread through these areas.
My masters in the Ecclesiarchy have called for a Day of Atonement. You must beg our dear Saint Messelina Gloriana for her forgiveness and protection for our beloved Tertium.
Pray at her Blessed Altars and scour the hive for any Holy Relics you can find. Only through devotion can we hope to save our city.

Sister Hestia Prine": To make progress in the event, you need to play missions with the Atonement condition, interact with the shrines presented in the missions and defeat the enemies which show up after activation. Along the way you can also gather holy relics for additional event progress.: The rewards will be Ordo dockets, Plasteel, Diamantine and a cosmetic insignia. As a special celebration reward, those who complete the last tier of this anniversary event will receive 500 Aquilas.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365286/72e11bca6a81b42bc43725503870dfdd28d51786.png"]: Pray at the Blessed Shrines and search for holy relics to unlock the following rewards: 200: 50,000 Ordo Dockets: 600: 3,000 Plasteel: 1000: 4,000 Diamantine: 1600: 3,000 Plasteel: 2500: 100,000 Ordo Dockets: 3600: New Insignia: 4500: 500 Aquilas

We have added two Threat level unlocking bonuses for experienced players:

If you already have unlocked the next Threat level with another operative, you will receive a small bonus for each mission won. The bonus is doubled if you have two other operatives with that Threat level.
You will start receiving a winning streak bonus on your 3rd consecutive win, and maintain the bonus until you face defeat.

Overall we’re very happy with the outcome of the previous patch. Build variety has increased and win rates are more even between those builds. There are, however, a few points and outliers that we want to tackle.
Arbites
Arbites Vigilant
Duration 10s -> 12s
Retaliatory Force
Attack Speed 10% -> 15%
Castigator’s Stance
While we’re happy with the defensive power of the Ability, it’s currently being used a bit too frequently so we’re adjusting the Cooldown of it.
Cooldown 45s -> 50s
Walk it Off
The uptime and effectiveness of Walk it Off was simply too strong in comparison to similar nodes.
15% over 3s -> 10% over 3s
Veteran
Covering Fire
Duration 3s -> 6s
Lock and Load
Clip Size 15% -> 25%
Redirect Fire
Fire Team
5% Damage -> 7.5%
Duty and Honour
The long duration paired with the Low cooldown of Voice of Command gave the effect too high uptime.

Zealot
Punishment
Impact 5% -> 8%

Pious Cut-Throat

100% for 2s -> 75% for 2s
Riposte
Melee Damage 4% -> 3%
Psyker
Inner Tranquility
Peril Reduction 6% -> 8%
Kinetic Presence
Damage 7.5% -> 10%

Cooldown Regeneration 100% for 3s -> 60% for 5s
Ogryn

The Ogryn can still be extremely tanky without investing that many points into the defensive nodes. We’re increasing the power of a few nodes in the defensive parts of the tree with the intent that we will see more successful builds that prioritize defense.
Stay Close!

For the Lil’Uns
Cooldown 30s -> 20
Feel No Pain (Keystone)
Stack Replenish Rate 3s -> 2s
Get Stuck In

Stacks 4 -> 6

Overview
The Veteran Power Falchion is a 1-handed, single-edged sword which pairs elegance with deadly offensive output.
The Special action activates the weapon in a similar way as the Zealot Relic Blade, further augmenting its attack properties at the cost of increasing Heat.
The Power Falchion has a relatively reduced damage in activated mode compared to the existing Veteran Power Sword, compensated however by its ease of use and improved mobility values.
Compared to the Relic Blade, the power source is more reliable, leading to a longer activated total time (but at the cost of a longer cool down period).
Weapon Special
The Power Falchion’s Special action empowers the sword, improving its swings while it is active.
It particularly buffs the weapon’s Cleave values and Damage Multipliers against certain armour types (e.g. Carapace armour).
Activating the weapon Special will start filling a Heat bar. Each activated swing will also increase Heat by a small amount.
When the weapon is deactivated, the Heat bar will passively cool down.
If the Heat bar is completely filled, the weapon overheats. On overheating, the weapon deactivates and cannot be activated until the Heat bar is completely emptied.

notes.title: The weapon will also deactivate from the following actions

items.text: Automatically, when swapping out of the Power Falchion
Manually, when performing the Special action while the weapon is already activated.
After performing the Special activate or deactivate action, the attack chain will not be reset.
Additionally, the weapon will receive Block properties while activating or deactivating.
This will provide flexibility to weave in the Special action in between attack combos.

notes.title: Locke Mk III Spearhead Boltgun, Godwyn-Branx Mk VI Bolt Pistol

items.text: Overview
These new marks of the Boltgun and Bolt Pistol pack an even larger payload, dealing increased damage and impact to the target and everything in a huge area around it.
The bolt is set to explode on impact, causing it to trigger the full explosion also when hitting terrain, but removing any Cleave property.
Additionally, the explosive will be primed after only 3m, instead of the minimum 5m of the default marks.
However, the projectile direct hit offensive properties will be reduced, especially in their damage and Finesse scaling.
Also, the magazine and reserves will contain less ammo compared to the default marks.

For the Locke Mk III Spearhead Boltgun, the hipfire mode remains full-auto, but with a reduced rate of fire compared to the default mark. While this will make the damage potential less spiky when mag-dumping, it will also allow for an easier control of recoil and spread on continuous fire.

When we first released Darktide almost 3 years ago, we had clear goals for what each class should be and where they should shine. However, over the years the specialties and niches that we envisioned have slowly spread out across all classes, and it is most noticeable with the Zealot. The Zealot was supposed to be the melee class, but over time and with the Ogryn Rework and release of the Arbites especially, the Zealot has fallen behind. We’re looking to reinvigorate the Zealots tree with more build diversity, and increase its offensive capabilities in melee, while at the same time adjusting the power of the Ogryn and Arbites.

We’re taking a closer look at the Veteran and Psyker Trees as well. We have pruned some talents and consolidated others, done adjustments to the layouts to provide more interesting choices and reduced unwanted travel nodes. We’ve also given each of them a couple of new talents and done changes to existing ones.
Class Balance is an ever ongoing challenge, but we intend to take a slightly different approach as we want to increase the cadence of balance adjustments.
Worth noting: this means that Veteran, Zealot and Pskyer characters will see their talent trees reset.

The Zealot’s Talent Tree is getting a facelift, with plenty of talents removed, even more talents added, and the entire Layout has been rebuilt from the ground up. As mentioned in the previous section, the main goal is to increase build diversity. We have a secondary goal however, and that is to give the Zealot a strong identity in terms of where it shines.
Base Toughness
We’ve lowered the amount of Toughness obtainable through Stat Nodes, and have increased Base toughness to make up for it.
Abilities

The “Paul” was left behind in the latest big revamp of the Ogryn arsenal, but in this release we are giving it some extra polish.
The Special attack of the weapon was somewhat underwhelming, as it needed to create space and time for the activation only for a relatively mild payout.
We significantly increased the damage and impact values of the activated attack, both for the hit and the explosion, but also the explosion's outer radius and the damage inflicted within it.
To balance the additional power, the weapon will now enter a cooldown period before the Special activation can be performed again.
The cooldown is 12s, and the status of the Special will be conveyed by new visual and sound effects.
We also took a look at the general moveset and attack profiles of the weapon, with the goal of making it more well rounded with both easy to use and more advanced attack chains.

To strengthen the single target capabilities of the weapon, we added a new Heavy Strikedown attack with good damage and Finesse multiplier, which can be reached from Push, Special activate and Light 2.
You can use it to deal massive damage after the Special activation, but also to create simple Strikedown combos (e.g. Light 1 > Light 2 > Heavy > Light 1 > …)

Additionally, the Light 3 and Light 4 attacks will now gain a 10% attack speed bonus when looped (i.e. when continuing the Light attack chain after the first Light 4), simulating the increasing momentum of the combo.

Finally, we improved the Heavy Relentless profile properties and lowered the chain times of the Heavy 1 and Heavy 2 attacks both for the windup and when initiating following attacks, and did some fine tweaking on other chain times and actions.
